system.description:
Master of their sanctum, the thaumaturge briefly warps the space within it so that its doorways open wherever they wish, turning a closet into an escape route or a trap.

You may make any doorway in your haven connect to any other of your choosing, so a closet might open into the laboratory or a bathroom onto the back garden. Anyone following you through a door instead arrives where it would normally lead, letting cunning vampires strand pursuers in an oubliette. The power lasts until sunrise, and you may end it at any time. Retest with Occult.
